title: Window Corner Dual Resize
description: When dragging a corner where horizontal and vertical window splits meet, resize both axes at once like VS Code.
summary: Fixed corner resizing between perpendicular window splits. Corner pointer drags now drive both live react-resizable-panels groups through their imperative layouts, persist both axis sizes, use natural drag direction and pair-preserving minimum constraints, survive hot reloads through corner-local handlers, and isolate geometry per mounted Mode. Extended the existing UI test region with a mounted pointer-drag regression proving both row and column layouts change together.
